name: Trade Report Header 4
definition: Provides the details of the header for a trade transaction query message.

ReportExecutionDate.name: Report Execution Date
ReportExecutionDate.definition: Indicates the as-at day for which the report was produced.

MessagePagination.name: Message Pagination
MessagePagination.definition: Page number of the message (within the report) and continuation indicator to indicate that the report is to continue or that the message is the last page of the report.

NumberRecords.name: Number Records
NumberRecords.definition: Indicates the number of records in the page.

CompetentAuthority.name: Competent Authority
CompetentAuthority.definition: Specifies the competent authority that requires reporting of the transaction.

NewTradeRepositoryIdentifier.name: New Trade Repository Identifier
NewTradeRepositoryIdentifier.definition: Identifies the new trade repository to which the derivative is transfered to.

ReportingPurpose.name: Reporting Purpose
ReportingPurpose.definition: Underlying reason for reporting the derivative transaction.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
